# Vendored character inputs

Source: the owner's `grokbot-animation-anatomy-main` project, approved Ginger
showcase on 2026-10-21 (chat `01a15ee0-e9ee-78b2-bdb6-c338cd0eac2e`).
Its README declares MIT. Original file comments and recipe metadata remain.
`grok-player.js` is that project's engine port; `grok-recipes.json` records its
extracted upstream data source and SHA-256. `bot-shape.js` and
`solid-geometry.js` are the approved shape and closed-surface implementation.

ClawX normalizes line endings and changes the solid import path, hidden-document
frame suspension and static settling that preserves the requested state. Update these files from the
approved source as a group, preserving provenance and geometry regressions.
